comparison.objective: Apply an opaque primer coat while controlling brush loading and drips.
comparison.physical_skill: Brush handling, wiping, repeated dipping, contact strokes, and coverage control; no fine rotary adjuster or retention fastener.
comparison.success_condition: At least 95% opaque coverage, at most one drip, no off-target brushing, brush safely released; versions differ in fluid/bristle fidelity.
comparison.reason: Tests process-material application and spill avoidance rather than tuning machinery.
